note: Deterministic vectors for DECK-0010. Keys are SHA-256("cyberspace vectors: <label>"); AES-GCM nonces are the first 12 bytes of SHA-256("cyberspace vectors nonce: <label>"); BIP-340 aux randomness is 32 zero bytes. Readers MUST accept any valid signature. Cells are [x, y, z, id]. Not normative: where this file and the DECK disagree, the DECK is right.

arrangements.name: compiler
arrangements.note: The Compiler's recipe (§8.3): four Gridstone in a plus around a Ferrovein, a Glowcore on top. Box 3 by 2 by 3.

arrangements.name: compiler-glowcore-below
arrangements.note: The same blocks with the Glowcore under the plus: a different arrangement.

arrangements.name: one-gridstone
arrangements.note: A single Gridstone: the shortest encoding, 28 bytes.

arrangements.name: L
arrangements.note: Four Ferrovein in an L in the XZ plane: three along X, one more along Z at the +X end.

arrangements.name: L-turned
arrangements.note: The L turned a quarter turn about Y: a different key (§3.1).

arrangements.name: L-mirrored
arrangements.note: The L mirrored across X: a different key.

arrangements.name: hollow
arrangements.note: A hollow 3 by 3 by 3 cube of Gridstone, its centre empty.

arrangements.name: solid
arrangements.note: The solid 3 by 3 by 3 cube: differs from the hollow cube only in the centre cell.

arrangements.name: corner-pair
arrangements.note: Two Gridstone joined only at a corner: (0,0,0) and (1,1,1).

arrangements.name: special-and-extension
arrangements.note: A Genesis shard (197) on an extension id (300): ids are written as they are, in two bytes.

arrangements.name: diagonal-16
arrangements.note: A diagonal of 16 blocks through a 16 by 16 by 16 box, Gridstone and Glowcore alternating, each touching the next only at a corner: the longest encoding without a lock, 8,218 bytes.

location.note: The Compiler's recipe built with its box at (10..12, 4..5, 20..22) in dataspace. The location encoding is the standard encoding followed by the region key (§3.5).

h5.name: compiler-location-h5
h5.note: Location lock at height 5: the origin chunk (DECK-0009's origin, lookup id 3c5d8c49...c649).

h6.name: compiler-location-h6
h6.note: Location lock at height 6: a different region key, so a different key and lookup.

straddle.note: A box at (30..32, 4..5, 20..22) crosses the border x = 32 of the height 5 regions, so it has no location encoding at height 5. At height 6 it stands in the region at the origin.

gather.name: compiler-alone
gather.note: The Compiler's recipe in open air, struck on its Ferrovein: isolated, the recipe's lookup.

gather.name: compiler-struck-on-glowcore
gather.note: The same, struck on the Glowcore: the same group and lookup.

gather.name: compiler-corner-stray
gather.note: A Driftsilt (3) at (100, 49, 199), touching the plus only at a corner of the Gridstone at (101, 50, 200): taken with it, isolated, and a different lookup.

gather.name: compiler-clear-above
gather.note: A Gridstone at (101, 53, 201), two cells above the Glowcore: outside the grown box, left alone, still isolated.

gather.name: compiler-in-grown-box
gather.note: A Gridstone at (101, 52, 203): inside the grown box (y 49..52, z 199..203) but touching nothing: left alone, and the group is not isolated.

gather.name: L-notch
gather.note: An L of five Gridstone with a block in its notch at (0, 0, 2), touching nothing: the notch block is left, and the group is not isolated (§4.2).

gather.name: row-20-middle
gather.note: A row of 20 Gridstone, x 0..19, struck at x 10: the window is x 2..17, so 16 are taken, and x 1 and x 18 touch the group from outside the window: not isolated.

gather.name: row-16-ninth
gather.note: A row of 16, x 0..15, struck at x 8 (its ninth cell): the window is x 0..15, all 16 taken, isolated.

gather.name: row-16-eighth
gather.note: The same row struck at x 7: the window is x -1..14, 15 taken, x 15 touches the group from outside: not isolated.

gather.name: joined-outside-window
gather.note: Two Gridstone columns at x 0 and x 2, joined only by a bridge through x 1 at y 18, above the window (y 2..17 for a hit at y 10): only the 16 cells of the struck column inside the window are taken; the other column is not, and the group is not isolated, because its own top cell at y 18, outside the window, is in its grown box.

reject.reason: the runs expand to 17 cells, not 18

reject.reason: the box is 4 along X, but no cell is occupied at x = 3

reject.reason: two occupied cells with a gap between them, (0,0,0) and (2,0,0)
